title: Interpreting CLIP's Image Representation via Text-Based Decomposition

layout.note: A 2 x 2 grid cut by one horizontal and one vertical grey dashed rule: top left a left-to-right strip with the input photo, the token grid, a projection box and the representation; top right panel (b) with two heat-map photos; bottom left panel (a) with three columns of text lists; bottom right panel (c) with two heat-map photos. Each lettered panel has a coloured banner matching a tint in the grid.

lesson: Tie a schematic to its result panels by colour: tint a column, a row and their crossing cell in a grid of tokens, and give each result panel a banner in the matching tint, so the reader sees which slice of the model each panel interprets; reuse one photo across all heat-map tiles so the comparison is immediate.
